panels.title: Requests · 6h
panels.description: Shows the total number of HTTP/1 requests received by the web surface of the Orrery application over the last 6 hours. A higher count indicates more activity, while a sudden drop may suggest reduced traffic or a service issue.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:web AND _msg:~"HTTP/1" | stats count() reqs

panels.title: 4xx · 6h
panels.description: Shows the number of 4xx HTTP client error responses from the web surface in the last 6 hours. A higher count indicates more client-side issues with requests, such as missing resources or invalid input.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:web AND _msg:~"HTTP/1" | extract "\"<method> <path> HTTP/<_>\" <status> <bytes> \"" | filter status:~"4.." | stats count() reqs

panels.title: 5xx · 6h
panels.description: Shows the total number of 5xx HTTP error responses from the web surface in the last 6 hours. A higher count indicates more server-side errors, while a stable or decreasing count suggests improved reliability.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:web AND _msg:~"HTTP/1" | extract "\"<method> <path> HTTP/<_>\" <status> <bytes> \"" | filter status:~"5.." | stats count() reqs

panels.title: Bytes served · 6h
panels.description: This panel shows the total number of bytes served by the web interface over the last 6 hours. A higher value indicates more data being delivered, while a sudden increase may suggest heavier traffic or larger responses.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:web AND _msg:~"HTTP/1" | extract "\"<method> <path> HTTP/<_>\" <status> <bytes> \"" | stats sum(bytes) bytes

panels.title: stderr · 6h
panels.description: Lines the orrery-web container wrote to stderr in the last 6 hours. Not every stderr line is an error, but a jump is worth a look in the logs.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND container:orrery-web AND stream:stderr | stats count() lines

panels.title: Requests / min by status
panels.description: Shows the number of HTTP requests per minute grouped by response status code. A higher number of requests with 5xx status codes indicates more server errors, while a rise in 4xx codes may suggest client-side issues.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:web AND _msg:~"HTTP/1" | extract "\"<method> <path> HTTP/<_>\" <status> <bytes> \"" | stats by (status) count() reqs

panels.title: Bytes / min
panels.description: Bytes served by Orrery's web surface per minute, from its access log.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:web AND _msg:~"HTTP/1" | extract "\"<method> <path> HTTP/<_>\" <status> <bytes> \"" | stats sum(bytes) bytes

panels.title: Top paths · 6h
panels.description: Shows the 20 most frequently accessed paths on the web surface over the last 6 hours, measured in number of requests. A higher count indicates more traffic to that path, with the top paths being the most popular endpoints.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:web AND _msg:~"HTTP/1" | extract "\"<method> <path> HTTP/<_>\" <status> <bytes> \"" | stats by (path) count() reqs | sort by (reqs desc) | limit 20

panels.title: 4xx / 5xx requests (recent)
panels.description: Orrery's web requests answered 4xx or 5xx, newest first. Read it to see which paths failed and how.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:web AND _msg:~"HTTP/1" | extract "\"<method> <path> HTTP/<_>\" <status> <bytes> \"" | filter status:~"[45].."

panels.title: Recent access log
panels.description: Orrery's web access log (HTTP/1 request lines) in this environment, newest first.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:web AND _msg:~"HTTP/1"
